property_summary: The correct transfer function must revert if any of the external calls it makes does not succeed, so for any list of recipients and any amount, transfer either succeeds and all calls succeeded or reverts; the buggy version drops the require(_s) check and returns true even when a call fails, so it returns true despite a failed call.
change_summary: Replace the require(_s) call-success check with a no-op, allowing the function to return true even when the external call fails.
